input_files.rule: Tests create temporary directories. Production runs take an absolute folder path from the user. The helper must not follow symlinks or write outside scan_root.

contracts.output contract: Return scan, plan, apply-result, or undo-result JSON with plan_id, ok_to_apply or ok_to_scan, skipped reasons, and dry_run. --execute is the only mutating apply path.
contracts.rollback boundary: Undo sidecar lists completed moves. Dry-run makes no filesystem changes. Delete is forbidden.
